title: Feet beneath a star
hook: Movement can come from many small contacts.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: The second panel magnifies small tube feet extending from the underside of a sea star arm toward a surface. They can help with movement and attachment; the diagram does not model their coordination or speed.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: A sea star’s underside bears many small tube feet. What can these help the animal do?
